name: v0.3.0 — Update Detection Test Target
body:
## Update Detection Test Target

This release exists so the v0.2.3 update checker can detect it as an update.

The APK is the v0.2.3 build (VERSION_CODE=5). The GitHub release tag is v0.3.0, which the update checker parses as version code 300. Since 300 > 5, the update is always detected.

## Features (same as v0.2.3)
- Redesigned UpdateBottomSheet (bold heading + changelog card + Download/Cancel same row + in-button progress)
- AboutScreen: no inline update card, delete button on downloaded versions
- Downloaded-state tracking (Install instead of Download when already downloaded)
- Auto-cleanup of old downloaded APKs
- Immediate update check on startup (no 6h cooldown during testing)
